natural: there is no need at all

meaning.en: There is really no need to do something; it is quite unnecessary.
meaning.zh: 完全没有必要这样做。

examples.zh: 这点小事，你大可不必放在心上。
examples.en: It's a small matter; there's no need to take it to heart.

examples.zh: 只是普通朋友聚会，大可不必穿得这么正式。
examples.en: It's just a get-together of friends; you needn't dress so formally.

usage.en: Used as a predicate, often followed by a verb phrase; sounds like gentle advice or mild reproach.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后接动词短语，语气是劝阻或轻微责备。

meaning.en: Tickets are so sought after that it is very hard to get even one.
meaning.zh: 票太抢手，想买一张都很难。

examples.zh: 演唱会开票即售罄，现场一票难求。
examples.en: The concert sold out the moment tickets went on sale; it was impossible to get one.

examples.zh: 春运期间，回家的火车票一票难求。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival rush, train tickets home are very hard to come by.

usage.en: Usually a predicate or a news headline phrase; describes trains, concerts, matches and popular shows.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或新闻标题，常说演唱会、球赛、火车票等。

meaning.en: To take hold of a favourable chance when it appears and make use of it.
meaning.zh: 把握住有利的时机并加以利用。

equivalents: make the most of a chance

examples.zh: 年轻人要学会抓住机遇，勇于尝试。
examples.en: Young people should learn to seize opportunities and dare to try.

examples.zh: 公司抓住机遇，迅速打开了海外市场。
examples.en: The company seized the opportunity and quickly broke into overseas markets.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; often with 迎接挑战 in speeches, business and news writing.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常与“迎接挑战”连用，多见于讲话、商业和新闻。

meaning.en: A vast area frozen solid under ice.
meaning.zh: 大片大片的土地和江河都被冰雪封冻。

equivalents: frozen as far as the eye can see

examples.zh: 北国风光，千里冰封，万里雪飘。
examples.en: The northern scene: ice-bound for a thousand li, with snow drifting for ten thousand.

examples.zh: 隆冬时节，千里冰封，河面上可以走人。
examples.en: In midwinter the land is frozen for miles, and people can walk across the river.

usage.en: Scenic, bookish phrase, usually a predicate; often paired with 万里雪飘.
usage.zh: 描写冬景的书面语，多作谓语，常与“万里雪飘”对举。

meaning.en: Extremely strong, as if one's strength never ran out.
meaning.zh: 力气特别大，好像用不完。

examples.zh: 故事里的大力士力大无穷，能举起一头牛。
examples.en: In the story the strongman was immensely strong and could lift an ox.

examples.zh: 孩子们都以为超人力大无穷。
examples.en: The children all think Superman has boundless strength.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (力大无穷的巨人); used of people, giants and heroes in stories.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，多用于人物、巨人、英雄等。

meaning.en: Full of one wonderful moment or item after another.
meaning.zh: 精彩的内容一个接一个地出现。

examples.zh: 晚会节目精彩纷呈，观众掌声不断。
examples.en: The gala was packed with wonderful acts, and the audience kept applauding.

examples.zh: 这届运动会精彩纷呈，创下多项纪录。
examples.en: The games were full of highlights and set several records.

usage.en: Often a predicate after the event noun (比赛、演出、展览); common in news reports.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，前接比赛、演出、展览等，常见于新闻报道。

meaning.en: To uphold what is right and make sure wrongs are put right.
meaning.zh: 维护公道，使正确的、合理的主张得到实现。

examples.zh: 法院的判决伸张正义，也安抚了受害者家属。
examples.en: The court's verdict served justice and comforted the victims' families.

examples.zh: 他当了律师，立志为弱者伸张正义。
examples.en: He became a lawyer, determined to stand up for justice for the weak.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; formal, common in news, law and speeches.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，较正式，常见于新闻、法律和讲话。

literal: all the more · enough · precious · valuable

meaning.en: Very rare and valuable, well worth cherishing.
meaning.zh: 十分稀少难得，非常值得珍惜。

examples.zh: 这批老照片记录了小镇的变迁，弥足珍贵。
examples.en: These old photos record the town's changes and are priceless.

examples.zh: 在困境中他伸出的援手弥足珍贵。
examples.en: The helping hand he offered in hard times was precious beyond words.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (弥足珍贵的史料); formal, for relics, records, friendship and time.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，较正式，多说文物、史料、友情、时光。

meaning.en: Unlikely to achieve anything great, for lack of talent or drive.
meaning.zh: 很难成为有大作为的人。

equivalents: not cut out for great things

examples.zh: 他整天贪玩，不肯用功，难成大器。
examples.en: He plays all day and won't study hard; he is unlikely to amount to much.

examples.zh: 别人说他难成大器，他却偏要做出成绩来。
examples.en: People said he'd never amount to much, but he was determined to prove them wrong.

usage.en: Predicate; a judgement about a person's prospects, often a warning or a doubt that is later disproved.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多是对人前途的评价或警告。

meaning.en: Having children and grandchildren gathered around one, a picture of a happy old age.
meaning.zh: 子孙围在身边，形容晚年幸福。

equivalents: surrounded by one's children and grandchildren

examples.zh: 爷爷奶奶儿孙绕膝，享受天伦之乐。
examples.en: Grandpa and Grandma, with their children and grandchildren around them, enjoy family happiness.

examples.zh: 他盼着退休后儿孙绕膝，安度晚年。
examples.en: He hopes to spend his retirement years with children and grandchildren around him.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; used of the elderly, often in blessings and family stories.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，多指老年人，常见于祝福语和家庭叙事。

meaning.en: After going through a number of setbacks and detours.
meaning.zh: 经过好几次曲折和反复。

examples.zh: 几经周折，他们终于拿到了签证。
examples.en: After many twists and turns, they finally got their visas.

examples.zh: 这座桥几经周折才得以建成。
examples.en: The bridge was built only after a good deal of difficulty.

usage.en: Adverbial at the start of a clause, followed by 终于 or 才 for the happy outcome.
usage.zh: 常作状语放在句首，后接“终于、才”表示最终结果。

meaning.en: To put forward opinions and proposals to help a leader or organisation.
meaning.zh: 提出意见和办法，帮助把事情办好。

examples.zh: 市民纷纷为城市发展建言献策。
examples.en: Citizens have come forward with suggestions for the city's development.

examples.zh: 欢迎大家为学校建设建言献策。
examples.en: Everyone is welcome to offer ideas for improving the school.

usage.en: Verb phrase; formal, typical of news and official notices.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，较正式，常见于新闻和通知。

meaning.en: Used to lament that a talented person has died young, as if Heaven were jealous.
meaning.zh: 感叹有才华的人早逝，好像上天嫉妒他。

examples.zh: 这位年轻科学家突然离世，真是天妒英才。
examples.en: The young scientist's sudden death is a case of heaven envying talent.

examples.zh: 听到他英年早逝的消息，大家都叹息天妒英才。
examples.en: On hearing he had died so young, everyone sighed that heaven envies the gifted.

usage.en: Usually a standalone exclamation or comment; expresses grief, mostly in tributes and news.
usage.zh: 常单独成句，表示惋惜，多见于悼念和新闻评论。

meaning.en: Having many children and grandchildren, a sign of a flourishing family.
meaning.zh: 子孙很多，家庭兴旺。

examples.zh: 老人儿孙满堂，过年时家里热闹极了。
examples.en: The old man has a large family, and at New Year his home is full of noise and joy.

examples.zh: 祝您福寿双全，儿孙满堂！
examples.en: May you enjoy happiness and long life, and a house full of grandchildren!

usage.en: Predicate; also a common blessing for the elderly.
usage.zh: 作谓语，也是对老人的常用祝福语。

meaning.en: Having a grand, imposing sweep that inspires awe.
meaning.zh: 气派宏大，场面或规模令人震撼。

examples.zh: 这座建筑气势恢宏，令游客赞叹不已。
examples.en: The building is so imposing that visitors cannot stop admiring it.

examples.zh: 开幕式气势恢宏，场面震撼。
examples.en: The opening ceremony was grand in scale and stirring to watch.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (气势恢宏的场面); for buildings, ceremonies, music and writing.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，用于建筑、仪式、音乐、文章等。

meaning.en: Speaking in a way that shows education, wit and refinement.
meaning.zh: 说话很有水平，显示出修养和见识。

examples.zh: 这位年轻人举止大方，谈吐不凡。
examples.en: The young man is poised and speaks with real distinction.

examples.zh: 面试时他谈吐不凡，给考官留下了深刻印象。
examples.en: In the interview he spoke so well that he impressed the examiners.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 气度不凡 or 举止大方 when praising a person.
usage.zh: 作谓语，夸人时常与“气度不凡、举止大方”连用。

meaning.en: Rich fragrance spreading in all directions.
meaning.zh: 浓郁的香味向四面八方散开。

examples.zh: 厨房里香气四溢，大家都等着开饭。
examples.en: The kitchen was full of delicious smells and everyone was waiting to eat.

examples.zh: 春天的花园里香气四溢。
examples.en: In spring the garden is filled with fragrance.

usage.en: Predicate; for food, flowers and tea.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多形容饭菜、花朵、茶。

meaning.en: A night that seems to go on and on, often for someone who is sleepless, lonely or waiting for dawn.
meaning.zh: 夜晚显得非常漫长，常指孤独、失眠或在困境中等待。

examples.zh: 长夜漫漫，他独自坐在灯下，难以入眠。
examples.en: The night stretched on, and he sat alone under the lamp, unable to sleep.

examples.zh: 长夜漫漫，何时才能等到天亮？
examples.en: The night is endless; when will dawn finally come?

usage.en: Predicate or a scene-setting clause; also a metaphor for a dark era.
usage.zh: 作谓语或交代背景，也比喻黑暗的时期。

meaning.en: To bring lasting benefit to the people of a region.
meaning.zh: 给一个地方的百姓带来好处。

examples.zh: 他立志当个好官，造福一方。
examples.en: He resolved to be a good official and do good for his district.

examples.zh: 这家企业扎根本地，造福一方百姓。
examples.en: The company is rooted locally and benefits people in the area.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; commonly 官员 or 企业 + 造福一方, in news and speeches.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常说官员或企业“造福一方”，多见于新闻和讲话。

meaning.en: Widely repeated and recited by people, said of poems, essays and sayings.
meaning.zh: 被很多人传说、朗诵、称颂。

equivalents: known and quoted far and wide

examples.zh: 这首诗至今仍广为传诵。
examples.en: This poem is still widely recited today.

examples.zh: 他救人的事迹在网上广为传诵。
examples.en: The story of how he saved a life is being widely shared online.

usage.en: Predicate or post-verbal; passive sense, subject is a poem, story or deed.
usage.zh: 作谓语，含被动义，主语多是诗文、故事、事迹。

meaning.en: Full of highly skilled people, so competition is fierce.
meaning.zh: 本领高强的人非常多。

examples.zh: 这个围棋比赛高手如云，夺冠并不容易。
examples.en: The go tournament is full of masters, so winning will not be easy.

examples.zh: 北京的高校高手如云，竞争非常激烈。
examples.en: Beijing's universities are packed with talent, and competition is intense.

usage.en: Predicate; says a place or contest is full of experts, often hinting at pressure.
usage.zh: 作谓语，指某个地方或比赛能人很多，常暗含压力。

meaning.en: Entirely honest and free of any stain or wrongdoing.
meaning.zh: 干干净净，没有污点，也没有不正当的行为。

examples.zh: 他当了一辈子官，清清白白做人。
examples.en: He held office his whole life and kept his name spotless.

examples.zh: 我要让大家知道我是清清白白的。
examples.en: I want everyone to know I have done nothing wrong.

usage.en: AABB-style reduplication; predicate or adverbial, often with 做人 or 一生.
usage.zh: ABAB式叠用，作谓语或状语，常与“做人、一生”搭配。

antonyms: 黄泥巴掉进裤裆里——不是屎也是屎

meaning.en: Morale rising sharply, usually after a victory or good news.
meaning.zh: 士兵或团队的斗志一下子高涨起来。

examples.zh: 球队连进两球，场上士气大振。
examples.en: The team scored twice in a row and morale on the pitch soared.

examples.zh: 听到援军赶到的消息，守城将士士气大振。
examples.en: On hearing that reinforcements had arrived, the defenders' morale soared.

usage.en: Predicate; about armies, teams and staff; commonly follows a victory.
usage.zh: 作谓语，用于军队、球队、员工，多在胜利之后。

meaning.en: Reputation and influence greatly increased, usually after a notable success.
meaning.zh: 名声和威望一下子大大提高。

examples.zh: 这一仗打赢后，红军声威大振。
examples.en: After winning the battle, the Red Army's prestige soared.

examples.zh: 球队夺冠，俱乐部声威大振。
examples.en: With the title won, the club's standing rose sharply.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, in historical and sports accounts.
usage.zh: 作谓语，较正式，多见于历史叙述和体育报道。

meaning.en: Having clearly different spring, summer, autumn and winter.
meaning.zh: 春夏秋冬的区别很清楚。

examples.zh: 北京四季分明，秋天尤其美。
examples.en: Beijing has four distinct seasons, and autumn is especially lovely.

examples.zh: 这里四季分明，适合种各种水果。
examples.en: The seasons here are clearly marked, which suits growing many kinds of fruit.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (四季分明的地方); describes climate.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，描述气候。

meaning.en: The season of autumn, when crops ripen and the weather is fine.
meaning.zh: 秋高气爽、庄稼成熟的季节。

equivalents: in the golden days of autumn

examples.zh: 金秋时节，果园里挂满了红彤彤的苹果。
examples.en: In golden autumn, the orchard is hung with red apples.

examples.zh: 金秋时节，各地游客纷纷来到这里赏红叶。
examples.en: In the golden autumn, visitors from everywhere come here to see the red leaves.

usage.en: Time phrase at the start of a clause; bookish and common in news and essays.
usage.zh: 时间状语，多放在句首，常见于新闻和散文。

meaning.en: Physically weak and frequently ill.
meaning.zh: 身体虚弱，常常生病。

examples.zh: 他从小体弱多病，父母格外操心。
examples.en: He was frail and often ill as a child, so his parents worried a great deal.

examples.zh: 外婆体弱多病，需要人照顾。
examples.en: Grandmother is frail and often unwell and needs looking after.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (体弱多病的孩子); describes constitution, not a single illness.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，指体质差，不是某一次生病。

literal: in succession · voice · call out · good

meaning.en: Shouting praise repeatedly, in admiration or approval.
meaning.zh: 一声接一声地喝彩称赞。

examples.zh: 观众看到精彩表演，连声叫好。
examples.en: The audience, seeing the brilliant performance, kept cheering.

examples.zh: 大家尝了一口，连声叫好。
examples.en: Everyone took a bite and exclaimed in praise.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial before another verb; describes an audience or onlookers.
usage.zh: 作谓语，或作状语置于动词前，描写观众或旁观者。

natural: lean on the railing and gaze afar

meaning.en: To lean on a railing and look into the distance, often lost in thought.
meaning.zh: 靠着栏杆向远处眺望，常带有思绪。

equivalents: gaze into the distance from the rail

examples.zh: 他独自站在楼上，凭栏远望，心事重重。
examples.en: He stood alone upstairs, leaning on the railing and gazing into the distance, full of thoughts.

examples.zh: 游客们登上城楼，凭栏远望，江山如画。
examples.en: Visitors climbed the city tower and gazed out over the picturesque scenery.

usage.en: Predicate; poetic, evoking a scene of reflection or longing.
usage.zh: 作谓语，诗意较浓，常营造沉思或怀念的场景。

meaning.en: Enjoying a great reputation all around the world.
meaning.zh: 在全世界都有很高的名声。

examples.zh: 景德镇的瓷器享誉世界。
examples.en: Jingdezhen porcelain enjoys a worldwide reputation.

examples.zh: 这位享誉世界的钢琴家下周来我市演出。
examples.en: The world-renowned pianist will perform in our city next week.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (享誉世界的作品); formal, used of people, products and places.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，较正式，用于人物、产品、地方。

meaning.en: A caring wish that someone will look after their health.
meaning.zh: 希望对方注意健康、照顾好自己。

examples.zh: 天气冷了，你要保重身体。
examples.en: It's getting cold; do look after yourself.

examples.zh: 工作再忙也要保重身体。
examples.en: However busy work is, you must take care of your health.

usage.en: Often a closing line in letters, farewells and messages; often follows 请 or 一定要.
usage.zh: 常用于书信、道别和问候结尾，多接在“请、一定要”后。

natural: blow the facts out of proportion

meaning.en: To make things sound bigger or more serious than they really are.
meaning.zh: 把事情说得比实际更严重、更了不起。

examples.zh: 记者夸大事实，引起了不必要的恐慌。
examples.en: The reporter exaggerated the facts and caused needless panic.

examples.zh: 广告不能夸大事实，误导消费者。
examples.en: Advertisements must not stretch the truth and mislead consumers.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; often used when criticising reports, adverts and gossip.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，多用于批评报道、广告和传闻。

literal: toss and turn · hard · to sleep
natural: tossing and turning unable to sleep

meaning.en: Rolling about in bed, unable to fall asleep because of worries.
meaning.zh: 翻来覆去睡不着，多因为心事。

examples.zh: 明天就要考试，他辗转难眠。
examples.en: The exam is tomorrow, and he tossed and turned unable to sleep.

examples.zh: 想到那件事，她整夜辗转难眠。
examples.en: Thinking of that matter, she lay awake all night.

usage.en: Predicate; often preceded by 夜里 or 整夜, describes worry or excitement.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常与“夜里、整夜”连用，描写忧虑或兴奋。

meaning.en: Treacherous officials holding power and running the court.
meaning.zh: 奸诈的大臣把持朝政。

examples.zh: 朝中奸臣当道，忠良之士无处容身。
examples.en: With treacherous ministers in power, honest men have nowhere to turn.

examples.zh: 历史剧里常有奸臣当道、忠臣受害的情节。
examples.en: Historical dramas often have a plot of crooked ministers ruling and loyal ones suffering.

usage.en: Predicate or a clause about a bad era; also used jokingly for office politics.
usage.zh: 作谓语，指政治黑暗的时期，也可戏指职场的小人得势。

meaning.en: Receiving such a rare and special honour.
meaning.zh: 得到这样特别的荣誉。

examples.zh: 能获此殊荣，我要感谢团队每一个人。
examples.en: To receive this honour, I must thank every member of the team.

examples.zh: 他是首位获此殊荣的外国人。
examples.en: He is the first foreigner to receive this distinction.

usage.en: Used in award speeches and news; appears as a clause with 能 or 是……的人.
usage.zh: 多用于获奖致辞和新闻，常和“能、是……的人”搭配。

natural: pose for a group photo to remember it

meaning.en: To take a group photograph as a keepsake.
meaning.zh: 一起拍照，留作纪念。

equivalents: take a group photo as a keepsake

examples.zh: 毕业典礼后，同学们在校门口合影留念。
examples.en: After graduation, the classmates posed for a group photo at the school gate.

examples.zh: 游客在景点前合影留念。
examples.en: The tourists took a group photo in front of the attraction.

usage.en: Verb phrase, often follows a place or occasion; fixed in captions and news.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，常放在地点或场合之后，也常见于图片说明。

meaning.en: To run a business in an honest, trustworthy way.
meaning.zh: 做生意讲诚实、守信用。

examples.zh: 这家老字号几十年来一直诚信经营。
examples.en: This old brand has run its business with integrity for decades.

examples.zh: 商家应当诚信经营，不得欺骗顾客。
examples.en: Traders should run their business honestly and must not deceive customers.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; common in business slogans, regulations and news.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常见于商业标语、法规和新闻。

meaning.en: To pass a task down every level and make sure it is carried out.
meaning.zh: 把任务一级一级地布置并真正执行。

examples.zh: 安全责任必须层层落实，不能走过场。
examples.en: Safety responsibilities must be implemented at every level, not just for show.

examples.zh: 各项措施已经层层落实到基层。
examples.en: All the measures have been carried through down to the grassroots.

usage.en: Officialese; predicate or adverbial before 到, as in 层层落实到位.
usage.zh: 公文用语，作谓语或状语，常说“层层落实到位”。

natural: a scene of peace and harmony

meaning.en: A scene of peace, calm and good cheer.
meaning.zh: 整个气氛平和安宁，让人愉快。

equivalents: an atmosphere of peace and goodwill

examples.zh: 春节期间，小城里一派祥和的景象。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival, the little town is a picture of peace.

examples.zh: 村里一派祥和，人们安居乐业。
examples.en: The village is calm and harmonious, and people live and work in peace.

usage.en: Descriptive, bookish; often predicate or attributive (一派祥和的景象).
usage.zh: 描写气氛，较书面，可作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: Doing work without worrying about, or asking for, payment.
meaning.zh: 做事不在乎有没有报酬。

examples.zh: 许多志愿者不计报酬，坚持为社区服务。
examples.en: Many volunteers serve the community without asking for any pay.

examples.zh: 他不计报酬地帮乡亲们修房子。
examples.en: He helped his neighbours repair their houses without expecting payment.

usage.en: Often adverbial, 不计报酬地 + verb; typical of praise for volunteers.
usage.zh: 常作状语，“不计报酬地＋动词”，多用于称赞志愿者。

meaning.en: Not moving at all; staying perfectly still.
meaning.zh: 一点儿也不动。

examples.zh: 猫蹲在窗边，一动不动地盯着小鸟。
examples.en: The cat crouched by the window, staring at the bird without moving.

examples.zh: 他吓得站在原地一动不动。
examples.en: Terrified, he stood rooted to the spot.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (一动不动地 + verb); also common as 坐着/躺着 一动不动.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（一动不动地＋动词），常说“坐着、躺着一动不动”。

meaning.en: So good that no fault can be found.
meaning.zh: 好到找不出任何缺点。

examples.zh: 这家酒店的服务无可挑剔。
examples.en: The hotel's service is impeccable.

examples.zh: 他的表现无可挑剔，赢得了评委的一致好评。
examples.en: His performance was flawless and won unanimous praise from the judges.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (无可挑剔的服务); strongly positive.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，褒义很强。

meaning.en: A principle of giving income in proportion to the work a person has done.
meaning.zh: 按照每个人付出劳动的多少来分配报酬。

examples.zh: 公司实行按劳分配，多劳多得。
examples.en: The company pays according to work done: the more you do, the more you earn.

examples.zh: 按劳分配体现了公平原则。
examples.en: Distribution according to work reflects the principle of fairness.

usage.en: A term in economics and policy; mostly a noun phrase or a verb phrase after 实行.
usage.zh: 经济和政策术语，多作名词性短语，或接在“实行”后。

meaning.en: Well organised, with every part fitting logically.
meaning.zh: 组织严密，各部分安排得很合理。

examples.zh: 这篇论文结构严谨，论证有力。
examples.en: The paper is tightly structured and its argument is strong.

examples.zh: 这部小说结构严谨，情节环环相扣。
examples.en: The novel is tightly built, with each plot point linked to the next.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (结构严谨的文章); for writing, music, plans and buildings.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，用于文章、乐曲、方案、建筑。

meaning.en: You alone will bear the consequences of what you do.
meaning.zh: 由自己承担事情造成的后果。

examples.zh: 不听劝告，后果自负。
examples.en: If you ignore the advice, you bear the consequences.

examples.zh: 违规操作造成的损失，后果自负。
examples.en: Any loss caused by improper operation is at the operator's own risk.

usage.en: A warning or notice, often at the end of a sentence; a stern tone.
usage.zh: 常用于警告或告示，放在句末，语气严厉。

meaning.en: Having about the same strength as one another.
meaning.zh: 双方的力量或水平差不多。

examples.zh: 两支球队实力相当，比赛非常激烈。
examples.en: The two teams are evenly matched, so the game was fierce.

examples.zh: 双方实力相当，谁也不敢轻敌。
examples.en: Both sides are equally strong, and neither dares underestimate the other.

usage.en: Predicate, with subjects such as 双方 or two teams.
usage.zh: 作谓语，主语多为“双方”或两个队伍。
